selection.description: 100 distinct ranked domains selected for popular-site and complex-application coverage across eight categories. This is NOT the numeric top 100, a measured complexity ranking, or an unbiased compatibility sample. Each full application journey needs independently captured, site-specific checkpoints; category recipes are requirements, not recorded successes.

checks.description: Navigation committed and finished the recorded checkpoint without a renderer crash or security/network error.
Expected site content is visible, not a blank, bot challenge, consent wall, error, login wall or marketing substitute.
User scrolling changed the visible content and agent geometry consistently.
A real user/agent activation navigated to the intended content with the expected URL and history entry.
Back returned to the previous document, state and scroll position.
A real interactive demo/dashboard opened and its read-only filtering changed visible content.
